summary_md: **Muhammad Ayan ([@socialwithaayan](https://x.com/socialwithaayan/status/2116567606882967790))** lists ten repos for agent-made launch videos without After Effects: lemo-opuscar, openfilm, ffmpeg-skill, anything2explainer, FreeVideo (MiniMax H3 on 8 GB VRAM), manimgx, video-talkcraft, huashu-motion, motion-video-kit and motionmaxxing ([kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill](https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill), [FlashML-org/FreeVideo](https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeVideo), [academa-labs/manimgx](https://github.com/academa-labs/manimgx)).
